analysis:
The supplied changes are documentation only: docs/architecture/inference.md (head-text excerpts, lines 406-1203) and docs/developer/test.md (patch adding a date bump and a ModelCheckpointRestoreContentionLiveTests section at hunk +174). No source, crypto, auth, wire protocol, or config code changed in the supplied units, so no runtime security behavior changed. I found no concrete regression.

Things worth a later pass: the doc text describes the MTP idle-upgrade drain, the MiMo native owner/lease lifecycle, the media decode memory accounting, and encrypted SSD prefix cache defaults (exact 9B Bonsai identities default to paged attention and encrypted SSD prefix caching). These touch T-041 (prefix cache and TTFT oracle) and TB-007, but the doc only describes behavior, and the supplied excerpts show no change to the 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, or account-scoped cacheSalt. The doc states the cache identity and security checks still apply and the sampler is not part of cache identity.

The new live test in docs/developer/test.md runs against an isolated ephemeral cache with `env -i` and an allowlist of variables. It uses a local model spec and an absolute output report path, and it records timing observations only. It does not enable any production surface. The doc carries a limited claim that the report keeps every sample, including foreign requests; this is test-only data.

Limit: the diff of docs/architecture/inference.md is not supplied, only head text, so I cannot tell which statements are new versus pre-existing. If the code behind the documented claims, such as the 9B default SSD prefix caching, changed in this PR, it was not in the supplied units and needs its own review against T-041.
